messages:
sam: Heads-up: two low-impact OOMs last night (01:14 & 01:37 UTC) in the kv pool. They look related to compaction spikes. Opening this thread to convert PM follow-ups into tracked action items.

mira: Thanks. Short list from postmortem: 1) short-term cap/abort behind flag, 2) profiling (heapshots + jemalloc), 3) telemetry + dashboard, 4) RCA writeup.

devon: I reproduced with the mini harness. Heap grows after repeated compactions; flamegraph points at kv::compact_range helpers that allocate short-lived buffers. I can add compact start/stop markers and live-page gauges.

anya: I can implement a soft compaction concurrency cap + abort when free_mem < 10%, feature-flagged. Will prepare rollout plan with smoke tests and rollback. ETA 18h.

sre-bot: Ticket INF-3342 created: "kv compaction OOM follow-ups" assigned to mira, devon, anya. Priority: P1. Link: https://tickets/internal/INF-3342

sam: Owners & quick due dates:
- Anya: feature flag cap + rollout / due 18h
- Devon: instrumentation + repro harness / due 48h
- Mira: profiling plan + RCA / due 5d
- Sam: standby for capacity adjustments / due 24h

devon: Commands I'm using for repro:
./run_repro --qps 50 --duration 30m --trace compact --heap-profiler=sampling
scripts/collect_flame.sh --out /tmp/compact.svg

mira: I'll backfill metrics for 90 days: kv.compact.count, kv.compact.concurrent, kv.compact.abort_count, kv.live_pages.p95. Also check recent allocator upgrades.

anya: Rollout plan: dark metrics behind flag (no behavior change) -> canary 1% hosts with abort enabled -> expand. Rollback: flip flag and drain in-flight compactions.

sam: Add temporary alert: fire when compaction.abort_count > 3 in 10m or host free_mem < 8% during compaction.

devon: Status: instrumentation PR opened, waiting review. Blocker: need staging quota to run longer repro.

mira: Status: profiling plan posted; starting heapshots tonight. Will post initial diffs in 48h.

anya: Status: feature flag branch pushed, unit tests green, will enable dark metrics in 6h.

sam: We'll use this thread for daily 1-line updates until INF-3342 is closed. If urgent, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
